findings.title: Lightness value changed from 30% to 70% during dark-light-choose conversion
findings.body: In .embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a, the original rule was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`, but the conversion changed it to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. The light-theme branch's lightness was silently changed from 30% to 70%, making embedded-post usernames much lighter than before on light themes. The light argument should have stayed 30%.

findings.title: Custom-message-length light-theme color changed from 70% to 30% lightness
findings.body: The rule for .custom-message-length was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)` and is now `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. The light-theme value changed from 70% to 30% lightness (darker text), and the dark-theme value uses 70% where the equivalent desktop rule (desktop/modal.scss) uses 30% for the dark branch. This is inconsistent with both the original color and the desktop counterpart, so the mobile flag-modal character counter will render with noticeably different contrast than before and than desktop.

findings.title: Group-member name lightness changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: The .group-member-info .name rule was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` and is now `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light-theme branch changed from 30% to 50% lightness, altering the existing light-theme appearance instead of just adding a dark-theme fallback. The same unintended change is repeated in app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/user.scss (.group-member-info .name, 30% → 50%).

findings.title: Topic-map h3 color lightness changed from 20% to 50%
findings.body: The .topic-map h3 rule was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)` and is now `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light-theme value changed from 20% to 50% lightness, making the mobile topic-map heading significantly lighter than before on light themes, while the desktop topic-map h3 (desktop/topic-post.scss) keeps its 20%/80% pair. The first argument should have remained 20%.
